build90Provenance.interpretation: Byte hashes, not original pre-commit revision alone, identify the tested current sources.

evidenceInterpretation: Four real mobile admissions and scoped user play feedback do not complete sustained four-device lifecycle/ownership/travel acceptance.

Build 90: 67 core/storage checks, six native continuation groups, four legacy compatibility combinations, four-player desktop motion and six server recovery groups are retained passes, not rerun here.
The ten-minute sustained native run is on Windows 85, not a mobile/A10 qualification or a new build-90 soak.

Complete checkpoints and separate preserved local adventures do not implement an operation journal, iPad host election or conflict merging. A hard loss may restore a checkpoint older than the last rendered/accepted action.
Guarded parent controls and crash supervision have isolated proof but were last recorded unactivated for the actual family. Same-Windows-user backup/restore is not portable disaster recovery.
Garden returns are a limited item-policy implementation; there are no owned bedrooms/protected creations yet. Creek and video are fixtures, not finished destinations/media library.
